# Customize — Evidence

## Findings
<a id="findings"></a>

- <a id="research.frontend-src-components-customize.f035b397"></a>**1. The customize component directory owns four React components — CalendarSelector, ColorSwatch, DateRangePicker, and ModuleColorPicker — plus a barrel index file that re-exports them.**
  [`index.ts:1-12`](../index.ts#L1-L12)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-components-customize.68b3ae8e"></a>**2. The index barrel re-exports each customize component and its props interface: ColorSwatch, ModuleColorPicker, DateRangePicker, and CalendarSelector.**
  [`index.ts:1-12`](../index.ts#L1-L12)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-components-customize.320c84c5"></a>**3. CalendarSelector imports the Calendar type from @/services/calendarService for its calendars prop.**
  [`CalendarSelector.tsx:3-4`](../CalendarSelector.tsx#L3-L4)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-components-customize.e3c37fa6"></a>**4. DateRangePicker imports the Alert component from @/components/common to display its error message.**
  [`DateRangePicker.tsx:3-3`](../DateRangePicker.tsx#L3-L3)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-components-customize.4f3a0599"></a>**5. ModuleColorPicker imports GOOGLE_CALENDAR_COLORS and getColorById from @/utils/colors to build its color palette.**
  [`ModuleColorPicker.tsx:3-4`](../ModuleColorPicker.tsx#L3-L4)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-components-customize.88aa4669"></a>**6. CalendarSelector is a calendar selector dropdown with an option to create a new calendar, documented as covering requirements 4.2, 4.3, and 4.4.**
  [`CalendarSelector.tsx:15-20`](../CalendarSelector.tsx#L15-L20)
  [`CalendarSelector.tsx:21-279`](../CalendarSelector.tsx#L21-L279)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-components-customize.3a2d9382"></a>**7. CalendarSelector renders a loading spinner with the text 'Loading calendars...' while the isLoading prop is true.**
  [`CalendarSelector.tsx:135-142`](../CalendarSelector.tsx#L135-L142)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-components-customize.9a1474d2"></a>**8. CalendarSelector closes its dropdown and resets its create form state when a mousedown occurs outside the dropdown element.**
  [`CalendarSelector.tsx:40-58`](../CalendarSelector.tsx#L40-L58)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-components-customize.a89cc314"></a>**9. CalendarSelector's create form trims the entered name, requires it to be non-empty, calls onCreate, and surfaces an error message on failure.**
  [`CalendarSelector.tsx:96-123`](../CalendarSelector.tsx#L96-L123)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-components-customize.a70392c2"></a>**10. In the create form, pressing Enter triggers calendar creation and pressing Escape cancels it.**
  [`CalendarSelector.tsx:125-133`](../CalendarSelector.tsx#L125-L133)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-components-customize.62d4f05d"></a>**11. ColorSwatch renders a button showing a color circle and name, with a selected ring style, aria-pressed state, and a data-color-id attribute.**
  [`ColorSwatch.tsx:11-38`](../ColorSwatch.tsx#L11-L38)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-components-customize.ba4a1499"></a>**12. DateRangePicker renders labeled Start Date and End Date inputs of type date for a semester date range, and shows an Alert when an error is provided.**
  [`DateRangePicker.tsx:39-81`](../DateRangePicker.tsx#L39-L81)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-components-customize.ded4055e"></a>**13. DateRangePicker converts Date values to yyyy-mm-dd strings for its date inputs via the formatDateForInput helper, and parses input values back into Date objects on change.**
  [`DateRangePicker.tsx:13-16`](../DateRangePicker.tsx#L13-L16)
  [`DateRangePicker.tsx:25-37`](../DateRangePicker.tsx#L25-L37)
  [`DateRangePicker.tsx:57-57`](../DateRangePicker.tsx#L57-L57)
  [`DateRangePicker.tsx:70-70`](../DateRangePicker.tsx#L70-L70)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-components-customize.d7088822"></a>**14. ModuleColorPicker assigns a color to each module for identification in the calendar, rendering a color dropdown per module.**
  [`ModuleColorPicker.tsx:12-92`](../ModuleColorPicker.tsx#L12-L92)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-components-customize.ced95b58"></a>**15. ModuleColorPicker resolves a module's color from the colors prop, defaulting to color id '7' (Peacock, blue) when a module has no assigned color.**
  [`ModuleColorPicker.tsx:23-26`](../ModuleColorPicker.tsx#L23-L26)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-components-customize.4a705995"></a>**16. ModuleColorPicker defers rendering the interactive color dropdowns until after mount, showing a static placeholder list first to avoid hydration mismatch.**
  [`ModuleColorPicker.tsx:17-21`](../ModuleColorPicker.tsx#L17-L21)
  [`ModuleColorPicker.tsx:28-52`](../ModuleColorPicker.tsx#L28-L52)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-components-customize.486aad9d"></a>**17. ColorDropdown lists every Google Calendar color, marks the currently assigned one as active, and closes when a color is selected or a click occurs outside it.**
  [`ModuleColorPicker.tsx:101-170`](../ModuleColorPicker.tsx#L101-L170)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-components-customize.0a3898eb"></a>**18. CalendarSelectorProps requires a calendars array, a selectedId, onSelect and onCreate callbacks, an isLoading flag, and an optional error message.**
  [`CalendarSelector.tsx:6-13`](../CalendarSelector.tsx#L6-L13)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-components-customize.c9b5358c"></a>**19. ColorSwatchProps requires a colorId, a name, and a hex value, and accepts optional selected and onClick properties.**
  [`ColorSwatch.tsx:3-9`](../ColorSwatch.tsx#L3-L9)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-components-customize.9bdddf81"></a>**20. DateRangePickerProps requires startDate and endDate values plus onStartChange and onEndChange callbacks, and accepts an optional error string.**
  [`DateRangePicker.tsx:5-11`](../DateRangePicker.tsx#L5-L11)
- <a id="research.frontend-src-components-customize.fe945b7b"></a>**21. ModuleColorPickerProps requires a modules array, a colors record mapping module names to color ids, and an onChange callback.**
  [`ModuleColorPicker.tsx:6-10`](../ModuleColorPicker.tsx#L6-L10)
